What stood here: No budget is active and no model the employees run on is priced on both token sides, which the preflight now reports as spending_budget and model_prices: a reservation still holds a film's money against no limit, and every agent_run records cost_vr NULL. model_prices covers the LLM token sides only — not the voice price (per_1k_characters) nor the motion and image prices (per_second, per_generation), and not the secondary or tertiary model slots — because a check that half-covered them would report a pass certifying less than it looks like

Still open: the letter is called from _media without a try/except, matching the unguarded budget_refusal_letter call below it, so a raise inside it would fail the media stage instead of returning SKIPPED; the caveat lives in the request's evidence text rather than a column; and estimate_film_cost_micros still does not price the stills at all, so a film's image spend is outside the figure rather than counted as zero inside it
